title: Players move their own tokens, taking turns in combat
summary: Players can move their own map tokens freely, and during combat only on their character's turn.
items: New maps let players move their own tokens (Automatic): freely when there's no combat, and only on their character's turn while an encounter is running on that map. Movement is free again when combat ends.
The DM can always move anything, switch a map's player movement off, lock a token, or keep chosen characters still on a map.
Maps set up before this change keep player movement off, with a one-tap Turn on Automatic in Map settings › Players & display.
Players see whose turn it is at the top of the map, a hint when it isn't theirs, and their sheet's speed as a guide on their turn.
In turn-based rooms players can move their own token outside their room turn; combat initiative still applies.
A player without a token on the map can choose Place my token and tap a square.
The server checks every move, so older apps follow the same turn rules.
